discord_message:
# ⚔️ NEXUS | AZEROTH COMPANION
### 🌌 v9.0.0 — LIVING AZEROTH

**Our largest visual evolution is here.** Azeroth Companion now feels like a fantasy command experience rather than a collection of plain panels.

**WHAT'S NEW**
> 🏰 **Living Azeroth:** A cinematic, illustrated gateway with five interactive destinations.
> ✨ **Talent Forge Laboratory:** Reactive talent-node highlights and source-backed skill inspection.
> 🛡️ **Living Armory:** Selectable equipment slots using Blizzard-reported character items.
> 📜 **Adventure Journal:** Illustrated Mythic+, Raid and Reputation chapters.
> 🔮 **ZevRo | Azeroth Oracle:** Original fantasy assistant identity and guided interactions.
> 🎬 **Cinematic Modes:** Cinematic, Balanced and Performance settings with responsive visual effects.

Existing builds, character research, Battle.net connections, personal saves, Founder Identity and HYPER MUSIC are preserved.

**ENTER LIVING AZEROTH**
https://zevromxr-hub.github.io/nexus-application-gateway/azeroth-companion/living-azeroth.html

*Powered by ZevRo Development | NEXUS*
acceptance_gates: All five destination and studio links functional on PC and mobile

Talent Forge nodes keep real ranks, undo, redo, import, save and source data
Progression Journal tabs/exports remain correct for known Blizzard characters
Assistant full page and bubble interactions are accessible and correctly labeled as curated
Visual modes and reduced motion work on mobile without hiding core controls
Existing Cloudflare Battle.net verification, Founder and HYPER MUSIC remain functional
GitHub Release Validation and automated browser audits pass on the final commit
At least one real player and physical iPhone Safari test accepted
